// Package fixture is a test fixture: a line-by-line translation of
// ref_dec.c.txt into Go, as a hurried porter would write it. It is the PLANTED
// POSITIVE: copycheck must fire on it.
package fixture

const maxBands = 24

var bandEdges = [25]int{
	0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64,
	76, 88, 100, 116, 132, 152, 176, 204, 240, 280, 328, 384,
}

var windowCoef = [20]float32{
	0.0007, 0.0029, 0.0071, 0.0138, 0.0237, 0.0371, 0.0541,
	0.0745, 0.0977, 0.1229, 0.1495, 0.1763, 0.2026, 0.2276,
	0.2507, 0.2713, 0.2889, 0.3031, 0.3137, 0.3204,
}

type decCtx struct {
	gain      int
	numBands  int
	maxSfb    int
	reservoir int
	gb        getBitContext
	scale     [maxBands]int
	spec      [384]float32
	prev      [384]float32
}

func decodeSpectrum(ctx *decCtx, frameLen int) int {
	var band, k, start, end, escBits, level int
	var sign, mag int
	totalBits := 0
	var step, acc float32

	if frameLen > 384 || ctx.maxSfb > maxBands {
		return -1
	}
	for band = 0; band < ctx.maxSfb; band++ {
		start = bandEdges[band]
		end = bandEdges[band+1]
		step = float32(ctx.scale[band])*0.25 + float32(ctx.gain)
		for k = start; k < end; k++ {
			level = ctx.gb.getBits(3)
			totalBits += 3
			if level == 7 {
				escBits = 4
				for ctx.gb.getBits1() != 0 && escBits < 12 {
					escBits++
					totalBits++
				}
				mag = (1 << escBits) + ctx.gb.getBits(escBits)
				totalBits += escBits + 1
			} else {
				mag = level
			}
			sign = 0
			if mag != 0 {
				sign = ctx.gb.getBits1()
				totalBits++
			}
			acc = float32(mag) * step
			if sign != 0 {
				ctx.spec[k] = -acc
			} else {
				ctx.spec[k] = acc
			}
		}
	}
	for k = 0; k < frameLen; k++ {
		w := windowCoef[k%20]
		ctx.spec[k] = ctx.spec[k]*w + ctx.prev[k]*(1.0-w)
		ctx.prev[k] = ctx.spec[k]
	}
	ctx.reservoir += totalBits
	if ctx.reservoir > 6144 {
		ctx.reservoir = 6144
	}
	return totalBits
}
